name: Seared Cod with Dill-Scented Couscous & Caper Ranch Veggie Salad
ingredients: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: In a medium saucepan, bring broth to a boil over medium-high heat. Once boiling, remove from heat, add couscous, dill, and salt, then stir to combine. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes; fluff with a fork right before serving.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat cod dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add cod and pan-fry until golden and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and quarter tomatoes. Place in a medium bowl.
Drain and roughly chop capers. Add to the bowl with the tomatoes along with the carrots and dressing. Stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide cod, salad, and couscous between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
